import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
b62="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0

I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2

V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
L=b62.strip().split("\n"); aas=L[0].split(); idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(aas)}
S=np.zeros((20,20),int)
for ln in L[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for j,a2 in enumerate(aas): S[idx[p[0]],idx[a2]]=int(p[j+1])
def sw(a,b,go=11,ge=1):
    ai=[idx[c] for c in a]; bi=np.array([idx[c] for c in b])
    m=len(b); prevH=np.zeros(m+1); prevF=np.full(m+1,-1e9); best=0.0
    for i in range(len(a)):
        sr=S[ai[i]][bi]; H=np.zeros(m+1); F=np.full(m+1,-1e9); E=-1e9
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            E=max(E-ge,H[j-1]-go-ge); F[j]=max(prevF[j]-ge,prevH[j]-go-ge)
            v=max(0.0,prevH[j-1]+sr[j-1],E,F[j]); H[j]=v
            if v>best: best=v
        prevH,prevF=H,F
    return best
A="MDDTLSTVEGGMTETSSWSTTIATTTTTEAAKAGSMAVGIIVLIVVMVLLCCLLIICLPLLCLCGCCGLACSACLACDEGCCGEGGGGGCCGDDGGGCCGDGGGCGDCGDGCGDCTLDDD"
# null restricted to SHORT SINGLE-PASS TM D. melanogaster proteins (the strictest control)
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
  params={"query":"(proteome:UP000000803) AND (length:[80 TO 160]) AND (keyword:KW-0812)","format":"fasta"},timeout=50)
recs=[]
for blk in r.text.split("\n>"):
    blk=blk.lstrip(">")
    if not blk.strip(): continue
    h,*s=blk.split("\n"); recs.append((h.split("|")[1] if "|" in h else h,"".join(s).replace("*","")))
ok=set(aas)
recs=[(h,s) for h,s in recs if set(s)<=ok and h not in ("Q8MZA7","Q7KVM4")]
print("null: D. melanogaster transmembrane proteins 80-160 aa, n =",len(recs))
sc=np.array([sw(A,s) for h,s in recs[:350]])
hdr=[h for h,s in recs[:350]]
obs=70.0
print(f"TM-matched null: mean {sc.mean():.1f} sd {sc.std():.1f} median {np.median(sc):.0f} 90th {np.percentile(sc,90):.0f} 95th {np.percentile(sc,95):.0f} 99th {np.percentile(sc,99):.0f} max {sc.max():.0f}")
print(f"P(TM-null >= 70) = {(sc>=obs).mean():.4f} ({int((sc>=obs).sum())}/{len(sc)})")
print("top:", sorted(zip(sc.tolist(),hdr),reverse=True)[:8])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4))
ax.hist(sc,bins=40,color="#9aa6b2",label=f"{len(sc)} D. melanogaster TM proteins, 80-160 aa")
ax.axvline(obs,color="#c0392b",lw=2.5,label="CG13494 vs CG43405 = 70")
ax.set_xlabel("Smith-Waterman score vs CG13494"); ax.set_ylabel("proteins")
ax.set_title("Length- and topology-matched null for the CG13494 / CG43405 similarity")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
